REPORT Zelensky has officially confirmed the Ukrainian SBU drone-boat attack on a Russian missile corvette and cargo ships in Libya, releasing footage of the strikes. He stated that seven unmanned surface vehicles were used, sinking the Russian "Mercury" missile corvette and striking the "MV ANGARA" cargo ship. The cargo ship was allegedly being used to transport military equipment, although it doesn't seem to have been sunk. Zelensky also claims that a Russian Ka-27 helicopter was destroyed, although this doesn't appear in the video. This is the first official acknowledgement of Ukraine operating drones out of Libya.
